changelog: Harden AutoJs6 watchdog startup: wrap the whole startup path in try/catch and always establish the 20-min interval so a boot-cycle error can't kill the loop; guard.enforce() degrades (logs + proceeds) instead of auto.waitFor()-blocking when accessibility won't attach. Add device-tier watchdog-liveness check. Compact HANDOFF.md (1097->~230 lines, all durable facts kept) + freshen HACKING.md paths to the single-root layout.
